sources.title: Fees Archives - Florida Board of Nursing
sources.notes: First real monitoring pilot (post-Phase 4.7). Watches the exact same page and field already backing Florida's real, verified endorsementFeeUsd=$110 (Phase 2.5). The extraction pattern anchors to the 'MOBILE Endorsement Fees' heading specifically to avoid the page's other, coincidentally-identical $110.00 figure under 'Licensing by Exam Fees' (a different, unrelated fee type) and the $100.00 under 'Multi-state Upgrade Fees' (which appears earlier on the page). Live-fetch confirmed against the real page on 2026-08-09 before this fixture/rule was written.

sources.notes: Phase 4.11. Same official source/value as ny-endorsement-fee-monitor, but targets the TransferRule california-to-new-york.applicationFeeUsd field ($143) instead of the RN-facts field — the real-world fact (NY's endorsement fee) is identical regardless of which schema asks about it, since NY requires endorsement uniformly regardless of the applicant's origin state. Kept as a SEPARATE MonitoredSource (not merged into ny-endorsement-fee-monitor) to preserve the 1-source-to-1-field-mapping design and keep each schema's provenance independently auditable.

sources.notes: Phase 4.11. Same page as the existing florida-fee-schedule-monitor pilot, but a DELIBERATELY DISTINCT extraction rule anchored to the 'Multi-state Upgrade Fees' heading (not 'MOBILE Endorsement Fees') — targets TransferRule texas-to-florida.applicationFeeUsd ($100), a genuinely different real fee on the same page, not a blind reuse of the existing pilot's rule. Verified the two headings' figures don't cross-contaminate: the existing pilot's own fixture set (v2-changed, which changes ONLY the Endorsement figure) independently confirms this rule correctly reads $100 unchanged when the Endorsement figure changes elsewhere on the same page.
